description: This source file defines a utility for discovering Tailscale gateways on macOS. It includes structures for representing discovered beacons, functions for collecting candidate nodes, establishing WebSocket connections for validation, and resolving/timing out processes. It implements an asynchronous discovery process with configurable timeout and concurrency, focused on identifying Tailscale nodes that act as gateways.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: A structure representing a discovered Tailscale gateway beacon with display name, DNS, host, and port.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery
classes.description: An enum encapsulating static discovery methods and nested structures for discovering Tailscale gateways asynchronously.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: A struct within TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery holding async functions for checking Tailscale status and probing hosts.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: A private struct representing a potential gateway node with DNS name and display name.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: A private decodable struct representing the status JSON returned by Tailscale, including self node and peer nodes.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main asynchronous method to discover available Tailscale gateways within a specified timeout, returning an array of beacon structs.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Filters and collects candidate peer nodes from the Tailscale status JSON that are suitable for gateway detection.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Generates a display name for a peer node, prioritizing hostname trimming, or falling back to DNS name prefix.

methods.name: normalizeDnsName
methods.description: Cleans and normalizes a DNS name string by trimming, removing trailing dots, and lowercasing.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to find and execute the Tailscale binary to retrieve its status JSON.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path to the Tailscale executable from candidate paths and environment PATH.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a process with a timeout, capturing its stdout.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Runs a process synchronously and returns its output or nil if it fails or times out.

methods.name: commandEnvironment
methods.description: Prepares command execution environment, especially setting TERM variable for macOS GUI contexts.

methods.name: parseStatus
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a TailscaleStatus struct.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to a host to detect gateway challenge events asynchronously.

methods.name: isConnectChallenge
methods.description: Analyzes WebSocket messages to determine if they are a gateway connect.challenge event.
